title: Red Coat
writer: Joe D'Amato, Claudio Bernabei, George Eastman
actors: Fabio Testi, Guido Mannari, Robert Hundar
plot: Cormack, the lawman most feared by the rugged pioneers at the turn of the century, has a mysterious bond with "Caribou," an outlaw whom he has jailed. When Caribou escapes from prison, he returns to seek revenge.
